description_en: Blocks or unblocks specified IP addresses or CIDR blocks
description_zh: 调用SetDcdnFullDomainsBlockIP可以对指定的IP或IP段，进行封禁解禁操作
name: SetDcdnFullDomainsBlockIP

parameters.help_en: The list of IP addresses to block or unblock. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,). A maximum of 1,000 IP addresses are supported
parameters.help_zh: 封禁或解禁IP列表，有多个IP时请用半角逗号（,）分隔，最大支持1000个IP
parameters.name: ip_list

parameters.help_en:
The operation type. Valid values:
block: Blocks the IP addresses.
unblock: Unblocks the IP addresses
parameters.help_zh:
操作动作。取值：
block：封禁。
unblock：解禁
parameters.name: operation_type

parameters.help_en: The block duration, in seconds. A value of 0 indicates permanent blocking. This parameter takes effect only when OperationType is set to block
parameters.help_zh: 封禁时长，单位为秒。设置为0时表示永久封禁。仅当OperationType为block时有效
parameters.name: block_interval

parameters.help_en:
The block time type. This parameter takes effect only when OperationType is set to block. Valid values:

cover: The current request overwrites the existing configuration.
uncover: The system calculates and compares the time to retain the longest block duration.
If this parameter is left empty, the existing configuration is overwritten by default
parameters.help_zh:
封禁时间类别。仅当OperationType为block时有效。取值：

cover：当前请求是采取配置覆盖方式。
uncover：采取时间计算比对最长方式。
该参数为空时默认采取配置覆盖方式
parameters.name: update_type

Code.description_en:
The result code.

If the code is not 0, possible causes include incomplete parameters or incorrect parameter formats
Code.description_zh:
结果信息码。

Code不为0的可能情况：参数不全、参数格式不正确等
